title: Disclosure Manifest Builder
description: Hashes a folder of data-room files client-side, builds a Merkle-rooted disclosure manifest with an eddsa-jcs-2022 signature, diffs it against a prior version, and links out to anchor.ainumbers.co to timestamp the Merkle root.

files.description: Files selected in the browser for hashing

prev_manifest.description: Optional prior manifest to diff and chain against

mcp_tool_definition.name: build_disclosure_manifest
mcp_tool_definition.description: Builds a signed Merkle-rooted disclosure manifest from a digest list supplied by the caller. The agent supplies pre-computed path/size/digest entries; the worker never sees file contents. Returns the manifest object and Merkle root.
